# AI Phone Assistant: Humans Appear Behind the Scenes

You can ask AI to make phone calls. When you hear that, you might picture a future phone assistant smoothly taking care of requests. But in a feature Meta tested through Muse, AI did not make some of the calls. Trained contract workers called people on users’ behalf and handled the conversations. Human workers appeared behind the scenes of AI phone calls. It was a turn of events that makes you want to check the cast list again.

But this is not just a story about thinking it was AI and finding out it was a person. Explaining the reason for a call may require information about the user. Employees at the company worried that if contract workers handled the calls, sensitive information might be shared by mistake.
